narrative:
Credit losses were €15.8M in FY2025 — about 20 bps on a €7.9bn loan book, mostly individual corporate impairments (€11.8M). In 2026 they are a net €3.5M release year-to-date: two corporate cases were resolved and model-based ECL fell as house prices stabilised.

The budget carried €16.4M for the full year; the 9+3 forecast carries only €1.5M. That €15M swing is why operating profit still lands near the €106M guidance while the cost-to-income ratio is above target.
